title: 第21章 除内鬼第22章 准备去天兽森林
slug: 九阳武神第4746章是时候清场了
content_zh:
此时，高台之上，还剩下叶家高层，叶云飞，萧楚楚，和黄老。
“父亲，家族内鬼不除，今天发生的事情，还会重演。”
叶云飞突然一步踏前，目光逼视叶仲年。
“你什么意思！”
叶仲年勃然大怒，很明显，叶云飞是冲着他来的。
“如果我没有记错。
叶家的账目，是由你这条老狗管理吧。
刚才那些人来追讨的债，数额高达六万多块灵晶石。
而我们叶家，一年的总收入，满打满算，也不会超过四万块灵晶石吧。
我们叶家花钱，什么时候，变得这么大手大脚了。
简直就是入不敷出！
两千张兽皮，三十颗一阶魔兽的兽核，我们叶家真用得着吗？
父亲，我建议，好好查一下叶家的总账，看看叶仲年这条老狗，有没有虚报账目，中饱私囊。
甚至，为了争夺家主之位，不惜勾结外人，损害家族利益！”
叶云飞缓缓说道。
“你含血喷人！
我勾结外人，损害家族的利益，对我自己有什么好处！”
叶仲年朝叶云飞怒吼，同时，他的神情也是流露出来几分惊慌。
“把叶家搞得一团乱，就能凸显我父亲的管理无力，你就有机会，趁乱夺位。
对你，当然有好处。

你府上，一年前新招的管事萧万祖，真名叫秦万祖，是秦雄派来我们叶家，帮助你一起对付我父亲的。”
叶云飞淡淡说道。
叶云飞的话音一落，立即，叶天鹏，还有七位长老的目光，都是死死盯着叶仲年。
“飞儿所说，是真，还是假！”
叶天鹏盯着叶仲年，一字一字问道。
“各位长老，秦雄已经答应过我了，如果叶家由我来当家主，他可以放过我们叶家一马，不会再进行打压！”
到了这一步，叶仲年也是豁出去了。
他明白，自己所做的事情，肯定瞒不下去了。
“老狗，终于承认勾结外人了吧。
今天，之所以有那么多人来讨债，其实，你就是主谋之一！”
叶云飞冷笑说道。
“叶仲年，你干的好事！”
叶天鹏气得浑身发抖，厉声大吼。
一时之间，高台之上，气氛僵硬无比。
到了此时此刻，众人哪里还不明白，叶云飞所说的，全部属实。
“呵呵，今天真是开了眼界。
想不到，天下间，还有这等卑鄙小人，为一己的利益，居然不惜勾结外敌，来对付自己的家族。”
萧楚楚突然说话了，语气充满鄙夷。
叶仲年满脸通红，目光中蕴满怒火。
但是，萧楚楚的身份地位摆在那儿，他根本就不敢对萧楚楚发火。

都怪这个小杂种！
content_en:
At this time, there were still senior members of the Ye family, Ye Yunfei, Xiao Chuchu, and Huang Lao on the high platform.
"Father, if the evil in the family is not eliminated, what happened today will happen again."
Ye Yunfei suddenly stepped forward and looked at Ye Zhongnian.
"What do you mean!"
Ye Zhongnian was furious. It was obvious that Ye Yunfei was coming for him.
"If I remember correctly.
The accounts of the Ye family should be managed by this old dog like you.
The debt those people came to collect just now amounted to more than 60,000 pieces of spiritual crystal.
As for our Ye family, our total income for a year, even if we give it a try, will not exceed 40,000 pieces of spiritual crystals.
When did our Ye family become so lavish with money?
It’s simply impossible to make ends meet!
Two thousand animal skins and thirty first-level monster cores, do our Ye family really need it?
Father, I suggest that you check the Ye family's general ledger to see if Ye Zhongnian, an old dog, has made false claims and enriched himself.
Even in order to compete for the position of the head of the family, he did not hesitate to collude with outsiders and harm the interests of the family! "
Ye Yunfei said slowly.
"You spit out blood!
If I collude with outsiders and harm the interests of the family, what good will it do to myself! "
Ye Zhongnian roared at Ye Yunfei, and at the same time, his expression showed a bit of panic.
"Making the Ye family a mess will highlight my father's inability to manage, and you will have the opportunity to seize the throne by taking advantage of the chaos.
Of course it's good for you.
In your house, Xiao Wanzu, the newly recruited steward a year ago, whose real name is Qin Wanzu, was sent to our Ye family by Qin Xiong to help you deal with my father. "
Ye Yunfei said lightly.
As soon as Ye Yunfei finished speaking, Ye Tianpeng and the seven elders all stared at Ye Zhongnian.
"Is what Fei'er said true or false?"
Ye Tianpeng stared at Ye Zhongnian and asked word by word.
"Elders, Qin Xiong has promised me that if I am the head of the Ye family, he can let our Ye family go and will not suppress us again!"
At this point, Ye Zhongnian also gave up.
He understood that what he had done could no longer be concealed.
"Old dog, you finally admitted to colluding with outsiders.
Today, the reason why so many people come to collect debts is that you are actually one of the masterminds! "
Ye Yunfei said with a sneer.
"Ye Zhongnian, you did a good job!"
Ye Tianpeng was so angry that he was shaking all over and yelled.
Suddenly, the atmosphere on the high platform was extremely stiff.
At this moment, everyone still didn't understand that what Ye Yunfei said was all true.
“Haha, today is really an eye-opener.
Unexpectedly, there are such despicable people in the world who would not hesitate to collude with foreign enemies to deal with their own family for their own benefit. "
Xiao Chuchu suddenly spoke, her tone full of contempt.
Ye Zhongnian's face was red and his eyes were full of anger.
However, given Xiao Chuchu's status, he did not dare to get angry at Xiao Chuchu.
It's all this little bastard's fault!
